# Workspace instructions

- Project: responsive single-page site for Group Informatika Universitas Faletehan.
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, and lucide-react.
- Keep page sections in `src/sections/`, shared UI in `src/components/`, and sample content in `src/data/siteData.ts`.
- Keep global styles, motion, and visual refinements in separate files under `src/styles/`.
- Run `npm run build` after code changes to validate TypeScript and the production bundle.
- Replace sample organization details and connect the contact form before publishing.
